entry.author: Kordia
entry.summary:
In a rapidly changing media landscape, flexibility is no longer a luxury—it’s a necessity. In this snippet from our latest Kordia Chats: In depth session, Arqiva’s Alaina Hall explains how cloud-enabled playout is helping broadcasters adapt without the burden of long-term, rigid contracts.

From rapid deployment of pop-up channels to a "pay-as-you-use" model, we’re committed to helping New Zealand broadcasters navigate uncertainty with scalable technology.

Learn how our cloud and OTT solutions can transform your operations: 👉 https://www.kordia.co.nz/broadcast/cloud-and-ott-solutions

#Broadcasting #Innovation #CloudPlayout #KordiaChats
